name: CEILING_SWEEP_ML
source: Values chosen to show how results depend on the unsourced ceiling.

name: SENSOR_SCENARIOS
source: Sweep of error types and sizes; posture changes are represented by the misalignment scenario (Toymus 2024 tested supine only).

name: USER_SCENARIOS
source: No data exist on how people with SCI respond to a fullness alert. Delays are uniform distributions chosen to span 'prompt' (0.5-5 min) and 'delayed' (30-90 min).

name: STIM_PATTERNS
source: Grid declared before any stimulation run. 0.6 = upstream healthy voiding detrusor drive (SOURCED model value); 1.0 = maximum. Sphincter 0.5 = co-activation at the storage level (ASSUMED, unvalidated conflict); 0.0 = no co-activation.

name: REFERENCE_STIM
source: Declared before running: co-activation (the conservative assumption) with intermittent bursts.

name: STIM_MAP_GRID
source: Stage 5 characterisation grid (open-loop stimulation from a full bladder).

name: PRESSURE_SCENARIOS
source: Hypothetical implant channel; no published accuracy exists. 'ok' still has 2 cmH2O noise.

name: EXTRA_SENSOR_FAULTS
source: Frozen-output faults that give a stuck device estimate (Experiment 4).

name: EMPTYING_CLASSES
source: Voided fraction of the pre-session volume: >= 0.95 complete, >= 0.10 partial, else none.

name: dt_s
source: lower-urinary-tract-sim v1.3.0 (Lister et al. 2025, R Soc Open Sci 12:242062), paper_figures notebooks. Must stay < 0.4 s: forward Euler on the sphincter equation (tau_S = 0.2 s) diverges above that (Stage 2 finding).

name: duration_s
source: One simulated day: long enough for several filling cycles.

name: seed
source: Seed used in lower-urinary-tract-sim v1.3.0 (Lister et al. 2025, R Soc Open Sci 12:242062) notebooks (an arbitrary but fixed choice).

name: inflow_noise
source: lower-urinary-tract-sim v1.3.0 (Lister et al. 2025, R Soc Open Sci 12:242062) default. Note: raises mean inflow from 0.017 to ~0.023 mL/s (Stage 2).

name: initial_volume_ml
source: lower-urinary-tract-sim v1.3.0 (Lister et al. 2025, R Soc Open Sci 12:242062) starts from an empty bladder.

name: enabled
source: Experiments 1-4 all use the simplified SCI condition.

name: injury_level
source: ONE simplified condition: injury above the sacral cord, sacral reflex arc intact. The true injury level is unconfirmed. Other levels are not implemented.

name: voluntary_voiding
source: Sensation to the brain and the decision to void are lost (upstream is_voiding() trigger switched off).

name: coordinated_voiding_program
source: The descending coordinated void (detrusor on, sphincter relaxed) is lost.

name: storage_drive_profile
source: The upstream storage-phase drives (volume-dependent Gaussians) stand in for the intact spinal reflexes below the injury. The paper calls them signals 'from the brain', so this reinterpretation is ours.

name: fullness_reference_ml
source: lower-urinary-tract-sim v1.3.0 (Lister et al. 2025, R Soc Open Sci 12:242062) max_V_B (Table S1 lists it as New: no primary source). Used ONLY to scale fullness inside the neural drives, so they behave exactly as upstream up to 500 mL. Above 500 mL they are extrapolated.

name: drive_above_reference
source: How the neural drives behave above 500 mL, where upstream never goes. 'extrapolate' (default) = upstream formulas unchanged, i.e. least modification; 'hold' = drive frozen at its 500 mL value. Neither is sourced; both are reported.

name: volume_ceiling_ml
source: Placeholder. Upstream hard-clips volume at 500 mL; no sourced SCI value was found. Inflow arriving at the ceiling is discarded by the model, so results are reported as a sweep over several ceilings and the discarded volume is measured.

name: sample_interval_s
source: One reading per minute. Toymus 2024 pulses every 2.5 s but recorded in-vivo volumes every 30 min, so no sourced alert-system rate exists.

name: best_case_mean_relative_error
source: Toymus et al. 2024, Nat Commun 15:7216 (doi:10.1038/s41467-024-50397-8): wearable A-mode patch, 5 healthy volunteers, supine only, reference = B-mode ultrasound (not catheter), in-vivo mean relative error 11.17% (definition not stated). Used ONLY as a labelled best-case anchor: healthy, supine, BMI 18-23.7; not an SCI accuracy.

name: noise_model
source: reading = truth x (1 + e), e ~ Normal(0, s), with s chosen so that mean |e| equals the target mean relative error (s = MRE x sqrt(pi/2)). The real error distribution is unknown.

name: median_window
source: Estimate = median of the last 5 valid readings (robust to spikes).

name: confirm_n
source: Alert only after 3 consecutive valid estimates at/above threshold.

name: rearm_hysteresis_ml
source: Alert re-arms when the estimate falls 50 mL below threshold.

name: stale_timeout_s
source: No valid reading for 10 min -> device raises 'sensor stale'.

name: alert_thresholds_ml
source: Swept, never tuned: the trade-off is the result.

name: duration_s
source: 12 h covers the first fill past 500 mL and the leak onset (~7 h).

name: sphincter_scalings
source: Default and 10% weaker: the two Stage 3 baseline behaviours (no leak / leak).

name: physiology_seeds
source: Inflow-noise seeds (filling-time spread).

name: sensor_seeds_per_case
source: Repeats of each sensor scenario with new sensor noise.

name: reference_volume_ml
source: lower-urinary-tract-sim v1.3.0 (Lister et al. 2025, R Soc Open Sci 12:242062) max_V_B (Table S1 lists it as New: no primary source); see EXPERIMENT2_SUCCESS_CRITERIA.md.

name: false_alert_fraction
source: Alert below 300 mL true volume counts as false.

name: relative_error_floor_ml
source: Relative error only computed where true volume >= 50 mL.

name: max_duration_s
source: Primary cutoff, needs no sensor. The model's healthy void lasts ~27 s. Swept 30/60/120 s in Experiment 3.

name: volume_stop_ml
source: Stop when the DEVICE ESTIMATE falls to 100 mL.

name: pressure_ceilings_cmH2O
source: Swept. 55 is near this model's healthy-void peak (54.7). 40 echoes the detrusor leak point pressure linked to upper-tract risk in myelodysplasia (McGuire et al. 1981, J Urol 126:205-209; checked via secondary sources only); it is NOT a validated stimulation limit.

name: reference_pressure_ceiling_cmH2O
source: Middle of the sweep.

name: lockout_s
source: 30 min between uses.

name: pressure_sample_interval_s
source: Synthetic implant channel sampling.

name: pressure_max_age_s
source: Older pressure readings are ignored.

name: ultrasound_interval_during_stim_s
source: 60 s = unchanged; 5 s = faster sampling while stimulating. Swept.

name: post_stimulus_window_s
source: Flow up to 120 s after a session counts as that session's emptying, not as leakage.

name: session_caps
source: Given by the user. Per 12 h run, not per day. Swept in Experiment 7.

name: min_drop_fractions
source: Given by the user. Swept in Experiment 7.

name: readings_before_check
source: Equal to DEVICE.median_window, so the estimate judged holds no reading from before or during the session.

name: check_deadline_s
source: Reuses DEVICE.stale_timeout_s. Must not exceed the lockout.

name: alert_repeat_s
source: Reuses CONTROLLER.lockout_s.

name: duration_s
source: Covers the first fill, alert, emptying and refill.

name: alert_threshold_ml
source: Centre of the 350-450 mL band where the anchor sensor passed in Experiment 2 (a choice made after Experiment 2; 350 and 450 also run).

name: physiology_seeds
source: Inflow seeds.

name: sensor_scenario
source: Best-case anchor sensor.
